adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `removeMember` in `admin-group.js.es6`, which calls `self.get("model").removeMember(member)` inside the bootbox callback without any error handling or UI feedback. In `discourse/models/group.js`, `removeMember` performs an AJAX DELETE and only attaches a `.then(() => self.findMembers())` with no rejection handling. If the DELETE fails (e.g., 422 from `can_not_modify_automatic` or 500), nothing in this diff shows an error to the user and the members list won’t be refreshed, so the member remains displayed with no explanation.
